rubber: Immediate giant elastic rubber fist impact, deep body thud with a taut rubber snap and short springy recoil.
sword: Immediate sharp katana strike, three fast cutting blade swishes and a hard steel clash with a short ringing tail.
lightning: Immediate explosive thunder crack with sizzling high voltage arcs and a deep bass hit, short electric decay.
fire: Immediate roaring fire blast impact with a heavy low boom, rushing flames and hot crackling embers, short decay.
projectile: Immediate high velocity projectile hit, sharp rifle crack layered with a whistling slingshot snap and solid impact, short tail.
beast: Immediate brutal animal charge collision, muscular impact and brief feral bear-like growl with a sharp claw rake.
blunt: Immediate massive fist or iron club impact, crushing body thud with a sharp crack and low sub-bass punch, short decay.
candy: Immediate hard candy spear shattering into sticky viscous strands, crystalline crunch and elastic wet snap with powerful impact.
dragon: Immediate dragon blast explosion, deep beast roar under searing rushing breath and powerful rumble, short decay.
string: Immediate slicing wire attack, several taut thin strings whipping and snapping with razor sharp metallic zings and a tight impact.
stone: Immediate huge stone or diamond fist collision, hard crystalline crunch with boulders cracking and small rubble scattering.
room: Immediate surgical spatial energy cut, deep spherical pulse, clean shimmering blade sweep and a sharp teleport-like pop.
metal: Immediate magnetic metal fist collision, clattering scrap drawn together, dense industrial slam with resonant steel crunch.
darkness: Immediate implosive black hole impact, low vacuum suction rushing inward, heavy dark bass collapse and ghostly textured decay.
quake: Immediate earthquake shock punch, glassy air cracking into a huge concussive boom, tectonic rumble and fractured debris.
smoke: Immediate pressurized smoke burst striking a target, dense airy whoosh with a blunt metallic baton hit and hissing vapor decay.
